what_was_done: Changed Genie LiveMonitor from fixed watchlist-only collection to dynamic discovery before each sentiment cycle.
Added broad headline scanning through NewsScout first, with DataHub news route fallback only when no broad discovery provider exists.
Added ticker extraction from structured article fields, exchange/$ prefixes, and uppercase headline tokens with a denylist for common market/source noise.
Added discovery metadata to snapshots and pulse reports: origin, discovered, discovery headline/query/source/url, and analyst_score.
Updated the Genie cockpit panel so discovered rows show DISCOVER, rank, discovery headline, and pass discovery context into Bob's TICKER command and chart selection context.
Restarted only the API process on port 8002 and left the CEO/llama server on 8082 running.

risks: NewsAPI still logs HTTP 429 during per-ticker sentiment collection when quota is exhausted; broad discovery now prefers NewsScout and does not need NewsAPI by default.
Ticker extraction is heuristic and should continue to evolve as real false positives appear.
Dynamic discoveries are in-memory monitor state; historical sentiment snapshots are persisted, but the discovery universe itself is not yet durable across restarts.
next_step: Add provider circuit breaker/backoff for exhausted NewsAPI and persist Genie discovery candidates with TTL/rank so the analyst universe survives API restarts.
